notes.title: Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes: [p]SIDE ALLEY will be released on [b]Tuesday, October 21, 2025 (at  11:00 AM PT / 8:00 PM CEST)[/b].[/p][p]Thanks to those who’ve followed development so far. Everything is on track, and the remaining time will be used to polish, fix what needs fixing, and make sure the launch version is stable.[/p][p]More details closer to release.[/p]
